list_provenance.geeklist_title: Top 100 Games of all time - 2026 Edition
list_provenance.rank_method: Reverse the returned array position across the four API pages. For one-based sequence position p, derived list rank = 101 - p.
rank_method_evidence: The API metadata reports ordinalDirection=descending and sortType=user.
The API returned 100 unique list items over four pages in user-defined order.
The final API item is The Castles of Burgundy and its body says it is the author's number 1.
Boundary checks map API positions 51, 75, 76, and 100 to list ranks 50, 26, 25, and 1 respectively.
list_provenance.rank_field_warning: Nested item.descriptors rank and stats.rank are global BGG ranks, not this Geeklist rank. Do not sort by postdate or numeric list-item ID.

source_policy.publisher_preference: Prefer publisher/developer-hosted rules pages, PDFs, FAQs, and structured references.
source_policy.full_text_ingestion_requires: Explicit permission or a source license that permits indexing and redistribution in this plugin.
source_policy.conflict_behavior: Ask for the edition when it affects the answer; distinguish direct source support from interpretation.
source_policy.audit_pass_note: This pass searched official publisher/developer domains and excluded BGG-hosted files, aggregators, and third-party rule hosts from official-source counts.

user_submitted_source_policy.authority: User-submitted material is not authoritative merely because it is hosted on BGG or another public site.
review_gates: record permission evidence or keep out of full-text index
compare against known errata and edition conflicts
approve only the minimum permitted content for ingestion
user_submitted_source_policy.unreviewed_behavior: Do not index, redistribute, or present as authoritative. Recommend live lookup or ask the user for a permitted source.
